row: S4 - the chip ladder lets Up leave only one chip at a time
screen: Deck's own screen (Quick Access window 854x454, dpr 1.5)
setup: Chat 'wheatley fight', newest answer 'Soul Sanctum'; Show details open, 'This answer' tab has a ladder 'Chip k of 7'. Observed with a page observer that logged the chip label after every press.
pressed: Down from the tab row into the ladder and on until it left (11 Downs from Hide details to Ask). Up from Ask: input, preset chip, then 7 Ups in the ladder, then Up to the tab row. Session tab: 10 Downs.

seen.down: Down from the tab row entered the ladder at chip 1; each Down stepped one chip (the ring element stays the same); after chip 7 the 7th further press left to the preset chip. No dead press beyond the chip steps.
seen.up: Up from the preset chip entered at chip 7 (last); Ups stepped 6, 5, 4, 3, 2, 1 (log times 57s, 59s, 62s, 65s, 68s, 70s, 73s); the next Up left to the tab row. So Up needs 7 presses to cross a 7-chip ladder: 1 press to enter at 7, 6 to reach chip 1, 1 to leave.
seen.visibility: The ladder container is taller than the pane, so the harness reported 33% or 0% visible for 6 of the stops (ring on a container whose chips scroll inside it); the chips themselves were not measured one by one.
seen.sessionTab: Session tab has no ladder: one stop per turn row, each 100% visible except the summary card heading (33% behind the question box).

verdict: NOT REPRODUCED as a dead-press bug. The ladder steps one chip per press in both directions and leaves after the last chip, as the 09-26 note describes. The session decides if one-chip-per-press is the wanted behaviour.
